newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Grain, soybean basis steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Grain, soybean basis steady.

text.p: FOB grain and soybean basis values were steady and activity was quiet as brokers digested Tuesday's USDA monthly crop report, export sources said.
"We were basically reacting to the USDA report," one broker said. USDA raised its estimates for U.S. corn and soybean production but trimmed U.S. and world wheat stocks.
Brokers also noted USDA raised projections for soybean and soymeal exports to China and cut its estimate for Argentina's soybean crop.
But while there was talk about added demand, very little activity was noted.

In the wheat market, there were continued rumblings about Turkey looking for wheat but traders noted U.S. wheat prices were still high compared to Argentina and there was some speculation Turkey would look to South America.
"We're hearing about potential business to Turkey but nothing has arrived yet," one broker said.
